observations.behavior: Adds a new module `dashboard_widgets.py` in `products/experiments/backend/` that provides backend support for dashboard widgets, including functions to list and retrieve experiments and compute metrics. It also adds a new module `dashboard_widgets.py` in `products/experiments/backend/facade/` that provides the facade for the dashboard widgets.
observations.posthog_connection: This module provides the backend support for the dashboard widgets, including the experiment results widget and the experiments list widget. It also provides the facade for the dashboard widgets, which is used by the dashboard widgets to retrieve the experiment data.
